name: DB Viewer
author: GrandPlugins

sections.description:
DB Viewer lets you securely view your WordPress database directly from your website’s dashboard — no need to log in to your hosting account or use phpMyAdmin. Perfect for quick inspections and monitoring.

With the free version, you can:

  • Browse and view any database table
  • Inspect table structures and content inside WordPress
  • Safely explore your data without leaving the dashboard

🔥 Upgrade to DB Controller PRO to unlock powerful database management features:

  • Empty any table with a single click
  • Delete tables you no longer need
  • Rename tables instantly
  • Search for any value across all columns
  • Add new rows directly from the dashboard
  • Edit any existing row inline

This makes the PRO version a complete lightweight alternative to phpMyAdmin, built directly into WordPress.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/db-viewer directory, or install it directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Dashboard > Tools > DB Viewer to start browsing your database.
sections.faq:
Is it safe to use this plugin?

Yes. The free version only allows you to view your database, ensuring you don’t accidentally break anything.

Can I edit my database with this plugin?

Editing, deleting, renaming, and adding rows are available in the PRO version. Get it here: DB Controller PRO.

Do I still need phpMyAdmin?

For most cases, no. With DB Viewer and DB Controller PRO, you can handle common database management tasks directly from your WordPress dashboard.
